product_category.value: Clinical education platform built on a library of real patient video cases, for nursing, PA, EMS and medical education

evidence.quote: Leading clinical education platform with real patient video cases for nursing, PA, and EMS programs.
Over the past decade, ReelDx has evolved from being the Netflix of patient-provider interactions - with over 700 cases - to a robust learning platform.

product_category.note: The first quote is the about page META DESCRIPTION line. The product is video-based case study; the pages do not describe VR or interactive 3D simulation.

evidence.quote: Our 700+ real patient cases can be used in-person or online, synchronously or asynchronously.
ReelDx brings the clinic right to your device.

platforms.note: Web is based on 'online' use. The pages do not name a browser, app, or device type; 'right to your device' is not specific enough to add Mobile or Desktop.

value: Library of 700+ real patient video cases covering 1,000+ symptoms and conditions

ReelDx Skills assignments: SOAP notes, SBAR, vital sign interpretation, differential diagnosis

evidence.quote: Our cases cover 1,000+ symptoms and conditions and include vitals & demographics, differential diagnosis patient workup, and more.
Our library of 700+ real patient cases are HIPAA-compliant, peer-reviewed, and searchable by symptoms, specialty, location, demographics, and more.
Every patient - or their parent/guardian - has given full consent.
Faculty can assign - and grade - student assignments, including SOAP Notes, SBAR, Vital Sign Interpretation, and Differential Diagnosis.
Design your own question or assessment for your students
Faculty can even grade the submissions right in the platform to allow students to make progress asynchronously.
Assign individual cases or add them to a custom course to help our cases fit into your curriculum.
Our courses are aligned to prominent curricula in the nursing, PA, EMS, and medical worlds.
The ReelDx platform introduces LMS integration with Canvas and Blackboard.
